name: Star Lake Bioscience Co., Inc.Zhaoqing Guangdong
summary: Star Lake Bioscience Co., Inc.Zhaoqing Guangdong engages in the manufacture and selling food additives, feed additives, pharmaceutical intermediates, active pharmaceutical ingredients, organic fertilizers, and bio-based new materials. It operates through three main business lines: food and feed additives, biochemical raw materials and pharmaceutical intermediates, and organic fertilizers.
